topic: Mathar's recurrence conjectures for paths with increments 1, 0 and -3, and their generating-function companions
title: Mathar's path recurrences and alternative proofs of Prodinger's enumeration

creators.name: Wenlin Zhang
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: Using Prodinger's enumeration (arXiv:1912.06930v3, 2020, Theorem 1 and Section 3), we give alternative counting proofs and prove Mathar's eight-term recurrence for floor -2 paths (OEIS A379464, revision 20, second Formula, 29 January 2025, n >= 7) and his six-term recurrence for floor -1 (A379463, revision 16, second Formula, same date, n >= 5). An explicit differential-operator certificate transports the known Raney counts to the exact recurrences. We include every fixed lower floor by a finite polynomial correction, prove the recorded asymptotics, and correct the indexing and tree wording in A127902 and companion formulas in A069271.
summary: Written proofs of Mathar's two recurrences, the zero-floor recurrence and the recorded asymptotics, with a self-contained derivation of the earlier Raney enumeration and its all-floor polynomial correction. Companion corrections give the shifted A127902 binomial sum, ordered unlabeled rooted-tree interpretation, A069271 inverse-power coefficient 4*(-1)^n, exceptional multiplier m=-2, and corrected PARI factor. Exact symbolic identities and bounded integer comparisons accompany the proofs.
